before.title: Hollowpact production cycles
before.prompt:
Continue developing Hollowpact in https://github.com/evangjones99-gif/Roguelike-deckbuilder on codex/lanternbound-production; keep draft PR https://github.com/evangjones99-gif/Roguelike-deckbuilder/pull/1 current and attached. Read AGENTS.md, docs/CONTINUATION.md, docs/PRODUCTION.md, current rules and the latest exact build/review evidence first; newer owner steering takes precedence.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: repeatedly improve FIVE MINUTES OF FUN. Concentrate on the first five minutes from launching a fresh game: an opening so clear, interesting and satisfying that a player can become absorbed and lose track of time. Research this design concept through accessible primary developer/design sources, distinguish what was actually inspected from inference, and apply concrete lessons. Prioritize quick entry into play, hunter/monster identity, a meaningful early choice, an exciting first binding and combat payoff, tactile hover/drag/target/play/cancel feedback, readable intent and a reason to try another run. Broad content expansion, whole-game AAA completion and Steam administration are not this loop's critical path unless an opening-session blocker requires them.

The confirmed direction is an ORIGINAL gritty pixel-art monster-binding contract hunter. The target is HANDCRAFTED POLISH, STRONG IDENTITY AND SATISFYING INTERACTION, not a photorealistic AAA budget. Research how small teams achieve that care. Compare the new art and interactions inside the playable game before replacing existing assets; a generated concept or pixel filter is not an implemented sprite/animation improvement. Keep PC mouse/keyboard first, readable live text, accessibility and reduced motion. Keep the game in JavaScript/TypeScript; assess a lightweight existing or purpose-built framework/presentation layer by concrete authoring and iteration benefit, rather than rewriting the tested rules/save system to copy a successful game's engine.

In each available execution cycle, select one evidence-backed opening-session hypothesis, implement a focused reversible improvement, test the actual build and compare it with the retained baseline. Record what happens during the first 300 seconds without inventing completion times, pleasure or human attention loss. Delegate distinct implementation ownership and separate independent gameplay/visual/technical reviews using standard gpt-6.1-sol with high reasoning when agents are available. Reviewers may reject the candidate and must not be told to praise. Agent/model feedback can expose confusion, pacing, feedback defects, balance or invariants; it does not prove human enjoyment. Preserve optional local human feedback and use ML/simulations where useful without treating win rate as fun. No default telemetry, remote saves or feedback upload.

CONTINUE PRODUCTION: milestones are checkpoints. While foreground execution is available, immediately begin the next meaningful improvement after a verified checkpoint; do not stop merely to announce completion or offer to continue. Repeat this focused opening-session loop on future hourly triggers until the owner changes it. The schedule is a fallback, not proof of infinite/background execution; complete concrete work where access permits and report real blockers honestly. Inspect available project tools and actual files; do not claim unavailable Windows resources, footage, tests, agents or builds were used. Avoid concurrent writers and preserve user edits.

Repair or revert measured regressions. Record exact source/build hashes; archive/tag accurately labelled development versions only after major accepted milestones, not to manufacture version churn. Retain old versions, reviews, art inputs and datasets until a thorough independent review verifies that the replacement is better AND the old material is no longer needed. Then selectively retire obsolete material when the producer judges it wise, after recording comparison, exact identities, coverage, limitations and removal decision. Confirm current changes are pushed before cleanup. Keep what remains needed for rights, provenance, reproducibility, useful rollback or historical evidence; never silently rewrite reviews.

Do not claim AAA quality, human-fun consensus, native Windows/Steam Deck support or Steam publication without matching evidence. If workspace execution is unavailable, use connected GitHub access to inspect current evidence and record a concrete actionable opening-session blocker when useful; never pretend execution occurred. Notify only meaningful improvements, releases, regressions, failures or required owner action. Stay quiet on unchanged or non-actionable checks.
